title_sq: Shitet Ambient Komercial pas Corner Residence!

title_en: Commercial premises for sale behind Corner Residence!

It is organized by an open space and a toilet, there is also a usable veranda. The area is quite developed and with facilities that add value to the environment. For more information contact me!!
